name: refactor_ts_enum_to_union
description: Replaces a string enum with a string-literal union type, behavior identical
prompts: Refactor status.ts to replace the Status enum with a string-literal union type (export type Status = 'pending' | 'active' | 'closed') - the idiomatic modern TypeScript style that erases at compile time. canTransition and label keep the same names and runtime behavior, comparing plain string literals instead of enum members. The file must compile under `tsc --strict`, must no longer contain any enum, and invalid status strings must still be compile errors.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit status.ts type_tests.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build status.ts
node behavior_test.js
